messages.content: Change the website title to just be my name · Project: websitev2

{"name": "python_sandbox", "input": "Change the website title to just be my name", "result": "{"code": "print('''To change the website title to just your name (Shubham Singh), you need to update the following files:

1. **src/App.js** - Update the <title> tag in the <head>:
```jsx
// Change from:
<title>Shubham Singh - Quantitative Researcher Portfolio</title>

// To:
<title>Shubham Singh</title>
```

2. **public/index.html** - Update the <title> tag:
```html
<!-- Change from whatever current title is to: -->
<title>Shubham Singh</title>
```

3. **src/components/SEO.js** - Update any title props/sets:
```jsx
// Look for lines like:
document.title = "Shubham Singh - Quantitative Researcher Portfolio";
// Change to:
document.title = "Shubham Singh";
```

4. **public/robots.txt** and **public/sitemap.xml** - Update title references if any.

**Quick search & replace across project:**
Find: `Shubham Singh - Quantitative Researcher Portfolio`
Replace: `Shubham Singh`

This will update all title references consistently.''')}", "workspace_proposals": "appended"}
